paite: Kumpipa Darias akum lina in hichi ahong hi a, Kisleu kha, akha kuana, ani li ni in, Zekariah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: An Ngawl Thu A Dotna

paite: Huan amau Bethel a omte'n Serezer leh Regem-melek leh amite uh TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding in asawl ua,
sepaihte' TOUPA' inn a siampute kiang leh zawlneite kiang a thu va gen ding in, "Kum tampi sung ka na hihsa bang in akha ngana ah kei-le-kei kihihtuam in, kap a suun in an ka ngawl diam?" chi in.
Huai lai in sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
"Gam a mite tengteng kiang leh siampute kiang ah thugen in. Hiai kum sawmsagih sung, akha ngana leh akha sagihna a an na ngolh chiang un, kei a ding in, keimah ding in na ngawlta uhia?
Na nek chiang un, na dawn chiang un, noumau a mah ding in na ne un, na dawn uh ahi kei maw?
"Jerusalem akiluah lai leh ahauhsak lai a, akimvel a khopite leh Sim leh gam niam gam akiluah lai a zawlnei masate zang a TOUPA tangkoupih hiai thute ahi kei ua hia? chi in," chi in.
Huan TOUPA thu Zekariah kiang ah hiai bang in ahong tung hi.
heading: Thumanlouhna Gah Saltanna

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N thu agen hi: "Vaihawmna dik hih un, michih in a-unau tung ah zahngaihna leh lainatna ensak hen.
Meithai nuaisiah kei un, pabeite, mikhual, gentheite leng, na lak ua kuamah in alungtang in a-unau siatna ding gilou ngaihtuah kei hen, chi in,” achi hi.
Himahleh ngaihkhiak a-ut kei ua, genhaktak in akiheimang ua, azaklouhna ding un abil uh ahum uhi.

Ahi, suang tak bang in alungtang uh abawl ua, huchi keileh dan aza kha ding ua, zawlnei masate khut a ama Kha a sepaihte' TOUPA'N athukhakte aza kha ding uh; huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA a kipan nakpi a hehna ahong tung hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, "Ka kikou lai a angaihkhiak louh ziak un akikou chiang un leng ka ngaikhe sam kei ding," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.

"Himahleh atheih louh uh namte lam ah pingpei in amaute ka delhsak ding. Huchi in gam amau nung in akisegawp ding a, kuamah in akantan un alehkik kei ding uh; gam nuam asukgawp ziak un, achi," chi in.
